report.summary: A caller called: siding repair (two loose panels). Outcome: declined.

transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cascade Exteriors, this is Janice. Calls may be recorded. What can we help you with today?
Hi, a couple of siding panels came loose on the side of my house, can someone come fix them?
I'm sorry, we only do full replacements, so a local handyman company would be the best fit for that. Is there anything else I can help with?
I understand, but we don't take repair jobs at any size; a handyman would get that done quickly. Anything else today?
Thanks for calling Cascade Exteriors. Goodbye.
